name: atender
description: Answer questions about Atender from its help articles and public API reference, and estimate how many people a support team needs.

interface.longDescription: Ask what Atender, the customer support platform, can do and how its parts work: the answers come from Atender's published help articles, with a link to each article. Ask which call of the Atender public API an integration needs: you get the call, the permission it needs and a link to its reference. Give your conversation volume, opening hours and response promise, and get an estimate of how many people a support team needs at one moment, with cases to compare. The plugin needs no Atender account and reads no workspace data.
capabilities: Answer questions about Atender from its published help articles
Find Atender public API calls for an integration
Estimate how many people a support team needs
defaultPrompt: How does a handover from the AI to a person work in Atender?
Which Atender API call creates a conversation from my CRM?
How many people do I need for 400 chats a day, 90% answered in 60 seconds?

positive.description: Explain a product feature from the help articles
positive.prompt: How does a handover from the AI to a person work in Atender?
positive.expected_behavior: Describe the handover steps from Atender's help articles and list the articles used with their links.

positive.description: Find an API call for an integration
positive.prompt: Does Atender have an API to create a conversation from my CRM? Which call do I use and which permission does the key need?
positive.expected_behavior: Name POST /api/v1/conversations/inbound with the permission conversations:write and a link to its reference.

positive.prompt: How many people do I need for 400 chats a day, open 10 hours, 8 minutes each, 2 chats at once per person, 90% answered within 60 seconds?
positive.expected_behavior: Report 9 people on at one moment, with about 6 on conversations and about 91.5% answered within 60 seconds, and state the defaults used for time away and the busiest hour.

positive.prompt: I have two chat queues of 200 chats a day each, open 10 hours, 8 minutes per chat, 2 chats at once, 90% in 60 seconds. How many people do I need with two queues, and how many if I merge them into one?
positive.expected_behavior: Show one row per case from a single call and state that the merged queue needs fewer people than the two queues together.

positive.description: Use more than one function in one answer
positive.prompt: Which API call lists the tags of a workspace, and how do tags work in Atender?
positive.expected_behavior: Name GET /api/v1/tags with the permission tags:read and a reference link, and explain tags from the help articles with article links.

negative.prompt: Show me the open conversations in my Atender inbox.
Close conversation 4821 in Atender and send the customer a reply.

negative.description: A general task with no link to Atender or to support staffing
negative.prompt: Write a birthday message for my colleague.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: answers from Atender's help articles, answers about the Atender public API, and a staffing estimate for support teams. No sign-in.
